With a traditional fixed annuity, you’re guaranteed a fixed interest rate that provides dependable growth with no market risk. Lincoln MYGuaranteeSM Plus fixed annuity offers:
Growth for the long term. Your money grows at a predictable rate, with no risk of loss.
Protection that lasts. Your retirement savings stay safe; they’re never invested in the market.
Income certainty. When you’re ready to take income, you’ll know exactly how much you’ll get.
Legacy for loved ones. Any remaining funds go to the people you care about most.
